data.creator_notes:
A little experiment here, I couldn't get it to put {{user}} into one of these scenarios without it speaking for them so I decided to just embrace it. 

Use the first message to describe your character. I've noticed it speaks for you less often if you don't name the character and just describe them physically but it's still not 100% consistent. I also haven't tested very many LLMs with this, if it does anything particularly wild let me know in the comments and also let me know what you're using.

Despite the issues it's still a lot of fun and it's nice to have a character be able to sneak around without {{user}} needing to be part of the scene.
